stories.title: Oil surges to $100 per barrel. And, Trump imposes a new round of tariffs
stories.description: Oil surged to $100 per barrel after Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked two Saudi tankers in the Red Sea. And, President Trump overnight replaced expiring tariffs with a slew of new ones.

stories.title: Trump threatens a major escalation in Iran after 13 straight nights of strikes
stories.description: The U.S. continued airstrikes in Iran while Tehran launched retaliatory attacks on U.S. targets in the Gulf, as President Trump said he was close to deciding whether to launch "a massive attack."

stories.title: How the Houthis blockade of the Red Sea could affect the global economy

stories.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump

stories.description: Signing a nuclear pact in the Middle East is a bold move that has drawn criticism in the US and in Israel.

stories.title: Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal
stories.description: A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.

stories.title: US holds fire against Iran as media reports say Washington's stockpiles are dwindling
stories.description: Another night has passed without further US air strikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of nightly bombardments. US media reports that Washington's concerns over dwindling stockpiles of Patriot interceptors and other air defence munitions could be behind the pause in fighting.

stories.title: UNESCO adds West Bank site, Lebanese castles to World Heritage List despite Israeli opposition
stories.description: UNESCO added a major archaeological site in the West Bank and a group of historic castles in southern Lebanon to its World Heritage List, defying Israeli objections and reigniting a long-running dispute over the intersection of cultural heritage and politics in the region.
